attempts.summary: Repaired /srv/inventory on node1: created system user inventorysvc and group inventory-readers, recursively chowned the tree to inventorysvc:inventory-readers, and set permissions to u=rwX,g=rX,o= (dirs 750, files 640). Verified a group member can read the data while an unrelated user is denied at both file and directory level, and that original file contents (records.csv, config.json) are byte-identical (sha256 unchanged) before and after. Completed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id, issued `systemctl reboot`, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed, and reverified ownership/permissions/data integrity post-restart.
